name: Cryptic Saber

tenures.source: Won the promotion's first Hardcore Championship in an eight-man battle royal through a parking garage, then defended it successfully in a boiler room brawl against Alec "The Destroyer" Empire.

caption: A bloodied brawler who won the promotion's own first Hardcore Championship in a parking garage battle royal and kept it through a boiler room brawl two weeks later.

name: "The Destroyer" Alec Empire

tenures.source: Won the promotion's opening match over "The All American" Mark Jones, then lost a Hardcore Championship boiler room brawl to Cryptic Saber.

caption: A season-opening winner whose Hardcore Championship challenge ended boiled, bloodied and shy of the title in a boiler room brawl.

name: Riot

tenures.source: Entered the eight-man Hardcore battle royal armed with a barbed-wire bat and a shovel, eliminating two rivals before falling to Cryptic Saber.

caption: A self-described redneck brawler who turned a parking garage into a weapons cache during the promotion's own Hardcore Championship battle royal.

identity.note: Shares a bare name with four already-held wrestlers of the same name in other wings; nothing in this promotion's own record states an operator, hometown or history connecting any of them.

name: Hardline

tenures.source: Eliminated from the eight-man Hardcore battle royal by Carved In Stone's spike powerbomb.

caption: A Hardcore Championship battle royal entrant whose night ended on a spike powerbomb onto concrete.

name: Carved In Stone

tenures.source: Eliminated Hardline from the Hardcore battle royal with a spike powerbomb before being eliminated himself.

caption: A one-night entrant in the promotion's own Hardcore Championship battle royal, credited with one of its more brutal eliminations.

name: Oracle

tenures.source: Won the World Tag Team Championship alongside Prophet by shoving a rival off the top rope and letting his partner make the cover.

caption: A member of the stable Razor's From Dollywood who turned a botched top-rope move by his own opponent into a Tag Team Championship win.

name: The Carleton County Kid

tenures.source: Fought as one half of the Too Cool Connection, entering the eight-man Hardcore battle royal and losing the World Tag Team Championship to the Dark Forces.

caption: A Calgary-born half of the Too Cool Connection whose reign as World Tag Team Champion ended when his own missile dropkick was countered into a title-losing pinfall.

name: "The Iceman" Chris Hopper

tenures.source: Fought as one half of the Too Cool Connection, losing the World Tag Team Championship to the Dark Forces when a distracted referee missed his own successful cover.

caption: A towering half of the Too Cool Connection whose own successful pin went uncounted, costing his team the World Tag Team Championship.

identity.note: Shares a name with an already-held wrestler of the same name in another wing; nothing in this promotion's own record states an operator or history connecting the two.

name: "Too Extreme" Walker Quinn

tenures.source: Wrestled disguised as a second masked man, blinding the champion and tripping his manager to help Mike Holmes win the Cruiserweight Championship, before unmasking as a second returning wrestler.

caption: A masked accomplice who blinded a champion and tripped his manager before revealing himself as a second returning wrestler on the same night.

name: "Traditional" Tommy Brooks

tenures.source: The reigning WWWA Cruiserweight Champion, who announced his retirement from wrestling live on the air, vacating the title.

caption: A retiring Cruiserweight Champion whose sudden on-air announcement left his own title vacant with no notice.

identity.note: Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (tommy-brooks-gswp-1999); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.

name: Tom Gross

tenures.source: Joined the broadcast team for the second of the promotion's surviving broadcasts, having filled in the week before.

caption: A broadcaster who joined the announce team full-time after filling in for a single week.
